CustomField.description: Marks a Case the nightly sync closed itself because the balance cleared in Yardi (FSD 5.9.6 step 6, UAT AR-004). Distinguishes a resolution DPEG worked for from one that simply stopped being a problem - and if this is ticked on a Case nobody ever touched, the threshold is probably too low.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ticked when the nightly sync closed this Case because the balance cleared.
CustomField.label: Auto Closed By Sync
